text:
Alex: Heads-up — seeing a p95 spike on prod-eu inference runners, started ~10m ago. Can we do a quick 10-15m huddle? bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/bridge/xyZ-quick 
Jordan: On my way, grabbing recent logs :thumbsup:
Maya: Can you paste the metric/query you used? want to check kv cache hitrate and request distribution
Alex: Query I ran: `sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{env="prod-eu"}[5m])) by (le)` — kv_cache_hit_rate down to ~0.72, tail mass shifted to >1.5s
Priya: I can join in ~2m. tagging Liam (oncall) to make sure he's aware
ops-bot: ALERT: inference-p95-eu exceeded threshold (1.5s) at 1823454210 — paging oncall
Jordan: I'm in the bridge. quick inspect shows 2 workers OOMing and restarting. sample log:
```
OOMKilled at step=1045 memory=12.8GiB
runtime/cuda: out of memory when allocating 1.2GiB
kubectl logs -n inference runner-abcde -c infer
```
Maya: That could line up with the quantization change from PR #482 (eng-ml). @eng-ml can we confirm if that rollout hit prod-eu? https://git.internal/redwood/pr/482
Priya: Starting a canary rollback of the quant change on prod-eu now. will watch metrics and evictions.
Alex: quick ask: whoever's on the bridge, grab the pod restart timestamps and correlate with p95 spikes. if rollback stabilizes, we'll open a postmortem + immediate action items.
Jordan: rollback applied to 20% -> 100%, p95 dropped to ~0.9s after last deploy. no more OOMs so far.
Maya: Nice. action items on my side: 1) add eviction headroom to runner config 2) instrument per-worker memory accounting 3) add an automated rollback if OOM rate > 1/m for 5m
Alex: I'll draft the RFC for the automated rollback and the opt-in canary process. thanks all — we'll keep an async notes thread for follow-ups. :thumbsup:
